decision.governing_rule: rule 2: lower level governs a split (though here all factors converge unambiguously at L1, no split present)

decision.reasoning: All six factors point uniformly to L1: closely supervised, direction-driven work on a first assignment, well-defined characterization tasks with no independent ownership, breadth, or influence described. The title 'MTS I' is evidence from the source framework, not the level itself (rule 6) -- described scope maps to Meridian's Associate Engineer (L1) anchor, not a Senior Engineer or above equivalent.
